usecase-create-book.code:
usecase CreateBook(books: BookRepository)
  exec(input: NewBook) Result<Error, Book>
    taken = ~books.where({ "title": input.title }).exists()
    if taken
      return Err(Conflict("there is already a book '${input.title}'"))
    book = ~books.save(Book(title = input.title, author = input.author, year = input.year))
    Ok(book)

usecase-get-book.code:
usecase GetBook(books: BookRepository)
  exec(id: int) Result<Error, Book>
    ~books.find(id)

usecase-lend-book.code:
usecase LendBook(books: BookRepository, loans: LoanRepository)
  exec(bookId: int, reader: string) Result<Error, Loan>
    book = ~books.find(bookId)
    if book == null
      return Err(NotFound("book not found"))
    if not book.available
      return Err(Conflict("book is not available"))
    book.available = false
    loan = Loan(bookId = bookId, reader = reader, returned = false)
    ~loans.save(loan)
    Ok(loan)

tests-create-book.code:
tests Books
  books: BooksAppComponent = inject<BooksAppComponent>()

  @test("creates a book and refuses the same title")
  checkDuplicate()
    book = NewBook(title = "Dune", author = "Herbert", year = 1965)
    first = ~books.create(book)
    expect(first.isOk)
    second = ~books.create(book)
    expect(second.error.status == 409)

tests-missing-book.code:
tests Missing
  books: BooksAppComponent = inject<BooksAppComponent>()

  @test("a missing book is 404")
  missingBook() void
    missing = ~books.book(999)
    expect(missing.error.status == 404)
